metadata.description: Claude Code marketplace for the docaviv2026 plugin — explore and schedule films at the Docaviv 2026 documentary festival (Tel Aviv, 28 May – 6 June 2026).

plugins.name: docaviv
plugins.description: מתכנן סרטים אישי לפסטיבל דוקאביב 2026. Explore films by taste, build conflict-free day plans, find back-to-back pairings, surface single-screening films before they disappear. Hebrew-first, English supported. Slash commands: /docaviv:start, /docaviv:update.
